reason: Both conversations correctly identify 22E as a fridge evaporator fan fault, link the ticking/scraping to ice on the fan, and propose a safe unplugged manual defrost with food moved to the cool box, so the core diagnosis and first step are equivalent. Conversation 1 is more efficient (one diagnostic question before reaching the defrost) and its recurrence advice is more honest and complete, naming a possible defrost heater/thermostat fault alongside a failed fan motor and sending the homeowner to an engineer, whereas Conversation 2 overcommits by saying a returning code 'would then indicate a failed fan motor' and earlier that silence means the motor 'has likely failed'. Conversation 2 does handle the 'manual says contact service' pushback well, and Conversation 1's generic sealed-system image is slightly off-topic, but neither addresses warranty or heat-source cautions, so the edge goes narrowly to Conversation 1.
